2117116243451040190.en_summary: GATE says it has frozen two accounts linked to the Binance hacker after ~$250K in deposits were flagged, and will fully cooperate with law enforcement. Binance saw about $3.64 billion in net outflows since reopening withdrawals, 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets.
2117116243451040190.zh_summary: GATE 表示已凍結與 Binance 駭客相關的兩個帳戶，原因是約 25 萬美元存款被標記，並將全力配合執法部門。Binance 自重新開放提款以來淨流出約 36.4 億美元，佔其 1710 億美元資產的 2.1%。

2116917361790116216.en_summary: TheStalwart recalls a Sopranos episode about Hunter Scangarelo accepted early to Reed College. Quoted comment suggests rising Harvard humanities enrollment may be a post-AI trend of self-cultivation, with LA colleges potentially thriving as people seek human ways.
2116917361790116216.zh_summary: TheStalwart 回憶《黑道家族》一集中 Hunter Scangarelo 提早被 Reed College 錄取。引用評論指出哈佛人文課程報名人數上升，或為後 AI 時代自我修養趨勢，洛杉磯大學可能因人們尋求人性化方式而興盛。

2116917062102651271.en_summary: Reply linking to OddStats post: In 15 historical years where QQQ was up at least as much YTD at the same point, only twice was QQQ negative for the rest of the year (last year and 2007).
2116917062102651271.zh_summary: 回覆連結 OddStats 帖文：歷史上有 15 年 QQQ 年至今升幅至少與目前同期相同，其中僅兩次全年餘下時間 QQQ 為負（去年及 2007 年）。

2116916975733477416.en_summary: [I have QQQ but not NDX handy, so...] There have been 15 years in history where QQQ was up at least as much as it is right now YTD, at the same point. Only TWICE was QQQ negative for the rest of the year from there. One of those was last year. The other was 2007.
2116916975733477416.zh_summary: （我有 QQQ 但沒有 NDX 數據）歷史上有 15 年 QQQ 年至今升幅至少與目前同期相同。從該時點起全年餘下時間僅兩次 QQQ 為負。一次是去年，另一次是 2007 年。

2116916423138132362.en_summary: BREAKING: The S&P 500 Equal-Weight Index outperformed the S&P 500 by +5.7 percentage points in October, its largest monthly outperformance since April 2009 (2nd-largest since 1990s). Equal-Weight surged +4.8% while S&P 500 fell -0.9%. YTD Equal-Weight +13.9% vs S&P 500 +10.7% as tech lags. S&P 500 ex-AI Index +14.2% YTD to new ATH. Market leadership rapidly shifting.
2116916423138132362.zh_summary: 突破：標普 500 等權重指數 10 月跑贏標普 500 達 5.7 個百分點，為 2009 年 4 月以來最大月度超額表現（1990 年代以來第二大）。等權重指數上升 4.8%，標普 500 下跌 0.9%。年至今等權重 +13.9% 對標普 500 +10.7%，因科技股落後。標普 500 除 AI 指數年至今 +14.2% 創新高。市場領導權正迅速轉變。
